channel.title: Science News Publishing
channel.description: Latest Scientific Discoveries, Breakthroughs, Space Research, and Technology News

item.title: First-Ever Black Hole Star Discovered by James Webb Space Telescope
item.author: Science News Publishing
item.description: NASA James Webb Space Telescope reveals a shocking new cosmic object - a black hole star radiating 100 billion times more energy than any star, discovered 660 million years after the Big Bang.

item.title: SpaceX Gears Up for Massive AI Shift with Starmind Satellite Network
item.author: Science News Publishing
item.description: SpaceX is pivoting into AI with Elon Musk predicting 99% of company value from AI by 2028, backed by a planned 1 million AI satellite network called Starmind and 10 gigawatts of computing power.

item.title: Total Solar Eclipse August 2026 Crosses Greenland, Iceland, and Spain
item.author: Science News Publishing
item.description: A total solar eclipse on August 12, 2026 swept a narrow path of totality across Greenland, Iceland, and Spain, while millions across Europe witnessed a spectacular partial eclipse.

item.title: Britain's Finest Jurassic Fossil Collection Sold to Abu Dhabi Natural History Museum
item.author: Science News Publishing
item.description: A 318-specimen Jurassic Coast fossil collection assembled by Chris Moore has been sold to Abu Dhabi Natural History Museum after UK institutions lacked the funds to purchase it.

item.title: AI Creates a Virus for the First Time - Stanford University Bacteriophage Breakthrough
item.author: Science News Publishing
item.description: Stanford University researchers used AI models Evo1 and Evo2 to design a bacteriophage virus from scratch - the first time AI has created a functional virus, published in the journal Science.

item.title: Jodrell Bank Observatory Faces Funding Risk
item.author: Science News Publishing
item.description: The iconic Jodrell Bank Observatory is facing a serious funding crisis that could threaten its continued operation and scientific contributions.

item.title: New Clue in Amelia Earhart Disappearance Mystery at Nikumaroro
item.author: Science News Publishing
item.description: Researchers have discovered a new clue at Nikumaroro Island that may finally shed light on the mystery surrounding Amelia Earhart's disappearance.

item.title: Little Red Dots Early Universe Discovery
item.author: Science News Publishing
item.description: Astronomers have made a groundbreaking discovery about mysterious little red dots observed in the early universe by the James Webb Space Telescope.

item.title: Orcas Observed Ramming Sunfish in Unprecedented Behavior
item.author: Science News Publishing
item.description: Scientists have observed orcas engaging in the unusual behavior of ramming ocean sunfish, providing new insights into killer whale social and hunting behaviors.

item.title: Pan Am Wreckage Discovered After Decades

item.title: Koala Cryopreservation Breakthrough Could Save the Species
item.author: Science News Publishing

item.author: Science News Publishing

item.title: US Space Force Tests New Facility at Meadowlands
item.author: Science News Publishing

item.title: Mystery Substance Discovered on Pluto and Titan

item.title: Nuclear-Powered Satellite BOHR to Revolutionize Deep Space Missions
item.author: Science News Publishing
item.description: The BOHR nuclear-powered satellite project promises to transform deep space exploration with unprecedented power and mission longevity.

item.title: AI Offers New Explanation for the Fermi Paradox
item.author: Science News Publishing
item.description: Artificial intelligence analysis provides a new theoretical framework for understanding why we have not yet detected intelligent extraterrestrial life.

item.title: GJ 3378b: A Potentially Earth-Like Planet Discovered
item.author: Science News Publishing
item.description: Astronomers have discovered GJ 3378b, an exoplanet with Earth-like characteristics that could be a candidate for habitability research.

item.title: Large Hadron Collider Shuts Down for Major Upgrade
item.author: Science News Publishing

item.title: Antarctic Titanosaur Fossil Discovery Rewrites Dinosaur History
item.author: Science News Publishing
item.description: The discovery of a titanosaur fossil in Antarctica challenges previous assumptions about dinosaur distribution and the ancient geography of Earth.

item.title: NASA's Swift Telescope Rescued From Retirement
item.author: Science News Publishing

item.title: New Marine Species Discovered in Brazil's Deep Waters

item.title: ESA Euclid Telescope Captures Stunning Milky Way Center Images
item.author: Science News Publishing

item.title: NASA Plans to Crash ISS Into Pacific Ocean in 2030
item.author: Science News Publishing
item.description: NASA has outlined its plan for the controlled deorbit and Pacific Ocean splashdown of the International Space Station by 2030, marking the end of an era in human spaceflight.

item.title: Vaquita Porpoise Digital Reconstruction Offers Conservation Hope
item.author: Science News Publishing

item.title: New Supernova Remnant Discovered in the Milky Way

item.title: New Air Force One Enters Presidential Service

item.title: Earth Black Box Project in Tasmania to Record Climate Crisis

item.author: Science News Publishing

item.author: Science News Publishing

item.title: Atlantic AMOC Ocean Current Collapse Risk Study
